name: Mega-Corps
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Cyber-Eyes
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Ranged Slayer Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Cyber-Eyes
specialRules.description: If this model has Cyber-Eyes, it always gets +1 to hit rolls from Cyber-Eyes (instead of only when shooting over 9" away).

specialRules.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rapid Advance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Versatile Reach Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Reach. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Agile
specialRules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Takedown Shot
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make X extra attacks against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Cyber-Eyes Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Cyber-Eyes. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Decimate
specialRules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Precision Marksman
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Precision Marksman
specialRules.description: If this model has Precision Marksman, it always gets +1 to hit rolls from Precision Marksman (instead of only when shooting over 9" away).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Ranged Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Slayer
specialRules.description: When shooting enemies over 9" away, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

specialRules.name: Versatile Reach
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when attacking enemies that already finished an activation this round, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
